clues: This city sits at the top of a long bay in the south of Alaska. Two arms of the sea reach in on each side of it.
The sea near this far north city keeps its cold from going too wild. Most of its rain falls late in the summer, not spread through the year.
This city began in 1915 as a camp of tents by a creek. Men came to build a rail line through the wild north land.
This city takes up more land than most, yet few folks live in most of it. A huge wild park fills much of its wide map.
Cargo planes from round the world stop at its airport for fuel. The FedEx firm keeps one of its main world hubs at that airport.
